title: Microsoft previews RDMA over USB4 for multi-PC local AI inference
summary: Microsoft released a Windows developer preview of RDMA over USB4 that lets multiple PCs share memory and GPU resources to run a single local AI model without a dedicated network card or switch. In a demo, three systems with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 chips ran 4-bit quantized Qwen3-235B-A22B at about 18.5 tokens per second. Microsoft says the preview will be distributed through Windows Insider.
